response.sql: SELECT AVG("wins") AS avg_wins FROM "driverStandings" WHERE "points" > 1 AND "wins" IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: "More than 1" is a strict comparison (points > 1), applied to each driverStandings row's season-to-date points. Rows with NULL points are excluded by the comparison, and rows with NULL wins are excluded explicitly. AVG is taken over the remaining rows without rounding.
